signIn.title: Welcome to Bespa
signIn.subtitle: Sign in to see your village.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.subtitle: You'll pick your village next.
signUp.toSignIn: Already have an account? Sign in
signUp.checkEmailBody: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. Open it to finish signing up.
signUp.checkEmailSlow: It can take a few minutes, and it may land in spam. If it does not arrive, use Google instead — it signs you in straight away.

validation.emailInvalid: That doesn't look like an email address.
validation.passwordTooShort: Passwords must be at least 8 characters.

auth.phoneLater: You can add and verify your phone number later, from your profile.

errors.offline: You're offline. This needs a connection — we'll retry when you're back.
errors.invalid_credentials: That email and password don't match. Check both and try again.
errors.email_taken: An account already exists for that email. Try signing in instead.
errors.weak_password: Please choose a longer password — at least 8 characters.
errors.email_not_confirmed: Please open the confirmation link we emailed you, then sign in.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.not_permitted: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.phone_unverified: Please verify your phone number first.
errors.seat_unavailable: Someone just took that seat. Please pick another.
errors.hold_expired: Your seat hold expired. Please pick your seats again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.invalid_input: That selection is no longer valid. Please pick again.
errors.queued: Saved. It will send when you're back online.

onboarding.title: Which village are you from?
onboarding.subtitle: This decides whose notices, directory and places you see — and who can see you.
onboarding.leafReady: That's the last level. Confirm below.
onboarding.leafEmpty: Nothing is listed under this yet. Go back and pick another.

pickLevel.ut: Which state do you live in?

detect.title: Use my location
detect.body: If you are in your village now, Bespa can find it for you.
detect.hint: Asks for location permission, then suggests your village
detect.denied: No problem — pick your village from the list below.
detect.unsupported: Location is not available on this phone. Pick your village below.
detect.failed: Could not get a location just now. Pick your village below.
detect.notFound: No village found near you. Pick yours from the list below.

home.noActivity: Nothing from your village yet. Notices and events will appear here.

privacy.title: Who can see you
privacy.subtitle: You decide what the rest of your village sees. You can change this any time from your profile.
privacy.assurance: Only people from your village can see this.
privacy.unlistedNote: You won't appear in the village directory at all, and the settings above stop applying.

hint.officials: Only the sarpanch and panchayat members

name.label: Your name
name.always: Always shown to your village. A directory of unnamed people is no directory.

show_avatar.label: Your photo
show_avatar.help: Hidden means your initials are shown instead.

show_occupation.label: Your occupation
show_occupation.help: What you do, shown under your name in the directory.

show_phone.label: Your phone number
show_phone.help: Your number is never shown in a list. It is looked up one person at a time, and you can see who looked.

in_directory.label: Listing in the village directory
in_directory.help: The list of registered villagers. Only registered users appear in it.

edit.title: Edit your profile
edit.subtitle: This is what your village sees, subject to your privacy settings.
edit.name: Full name
edit.occupationOtherHint: Type it in your own words.
edit.phoneHint: 10 digits, the way you would tell a neighbour.
edit.unverifiedNote: We cannot send a verification code yet. Your number is saved but stays unverified until SMS is set up.

notices.title: Notices
notices.opensPdf: Opens the PDF published by the district
notices.opensOriginal: Opens the original document from the district
notices.sharesNotice: Opens the share sheet, for WhatsApp and anything else on the phone
notices.shareFooter: Shared from Bespa — notices, transport and services for Kargil district.

occupationStep.title: What do you do?
occupationStep.subtitle: Pick the closest one. It helps neighbours find the right person — you can change it any time.

directory.title: Village directory
directory.callHint: Opens the dialler with their number
directory.empty: Nobody from your village has joined yet.
directory.noNumber: They have not added a number yet.

composer.title: Write a notice
composer.subtitle: Everyone in {{village}} will see this, and their phones will tell them.
composer.noticeTitleHint: One line. This is what people see first.
composer.bodyHint: What people need to know: what, when, and where.
composer.alertNote: An alert makes a sound on every phone in the village. Use it when it cannot wait.
composer.pinHint: Pinned notices stay above the others.
composer.publishHint: Sends the notice and tells the village
composer.queued: Saved. It will be sent as soon as you have a connection — it has not reached anyone yet.

contacts.title: Panchayat contacts
contacts.subtitle: These appear at the top of the {{village}} directory, with their numbers, for everyone in the village.
contacts.manageHint: Add or correct the cards above the directory
contacts.empty: No contacts yet. The sarpanch is the one people look for first.
contacts.name: Name
contacts.phoneHint: Shown to the whole village — this is the office’s number, not a private one.

gallery.title: Village photos
gallery.empty: No photos yet. Share one of your village.
gallery.caption: Say something about the photo
gallery.captionHint: Optional. It is shown with every photo you send now.
gallery.addHint: Pick up to ten photos; they send in the background
gallery.sent: Sent. The panchayat will look at it before the village sees it.
gallery.queued: Saved. It will send when you have a connection — nobody has seen it yet.
gallery.reviewHint: Opens the photos waiting for a decision
gallery.reviewIntro: Oldest first. A photo is not shown to the village until you accept it.
gallery.nothingWaiting: Nothing waiting. The village sees everything that was accepted.
gallery.reasonHint: The person who sent it will read this.
gallery.reasonRequired: Say why, so the person who sent it knows.

pick.denied: Bespa cannot see your photos. Allow it from Android settings.
pick.unsupported: This build cannot pick photos. It needs a newer app.

gallery.bannerHint: Choose which photos the village sees first
gallery.bannerIntro: Tap up to five photos. The number shows the order the village will see them in.
gallery.bannerNothing: No accepted photos yet. Accept some first.
gallery.bannerFull: Five is the most the home screen holds.
gallery.bannerSaved: Saved. The village will see these at the top.

places.title: Places
places.intro: The school, the dispensary, the mosque, the shop. Added by people who live here.
places.empty: No places yet. Add the first one.
places.searchHint: By name, in English or Purgi
places.addHint: Takes a photo and a location
places.noMap: Bespa has no map. Add a place while you are standing at it, and your phone will mark the spot.
places.stepCategory: What kind of place is it?
places.nameEnHint: As it is written on the board, or as people say it
places.photosHint: At least one, up to five. People find a place by its picture.
places.descriptionHint: Optional. What it is for, who runs it, how to find it.
places.noLocation: A place needs a location, or nobody can find it.
places.contactHint: Optional. Shown to everyone in the village.
places.timingsHint: For example: 10 am to 4 pm, closed Friday
places.sent: Sent. The panchayat will look at it before the village sees it.
places.queued: Saved. It will send when you have a connection — nobody has seen it yet.
places.duplicateBody: There is already a {{category}} within 150 metres. If it is the same place, go back rather than adding it twice.
places.duplicateSame: Yes, it is the same — go back
places.duplicateDifferent: No, this is a different one
places.reviewHint: Opens the places waiting for a decision
places.reviewIntro: Oldest first. A place is not shown to the village until you accept it.
places.nothingWaiting: Nothing waiting. The village sees everything that was accepted.
places.reasonHint: The person who sent it will read this.
places.reasonRequired: Say why, so the person who sent it knows.

pick.denied: Bespa cannot see your photos. Allow it from Android settings.
pick.unsupported: This build cannot pick photos. It needs a newer app.

locate.denied: Bespa cannot see your location. Allow it from Android settings, or put the pin on the map.
locate.unsupported: This phone cannot give a location right now. Check that location is switched on.
locate.failed: Could not get your location. Try again outdoors, or put the pin on the map.

village.title: About this village
village.noDescription: Ask your sarpanch to add a description.
village.statsIntro: Every figure shows where it came from and which year it is for.
village.editHint: Only you and other admins of this village can change this
village.descriptionHint: Two or three lines. What a visitor should know first.
village.historyHint: Optional. Longer; shown on the About page only.
village.coverHint: Optional. Shown at the top of the village page.
village.queued: Saved. It will send when you have a connection.
village.statMetricKeyHint: Lower case, words joined by _ — for example water_connections
village.statYearHint: The year the figure describes, not today
village.statSourceHint: For example: Census of India 2011. A figure with no source is not shown.
village.statSourceRequired: Say where the figure came from.
village.statKeyRequired: Lower case letters, numbers and _ only.
village.statsCensusNote: Ladakh's 2026 census is not published yet. Add the new figures as a new year when they are — the old ones stay, and the village page moves forward on its own.

helplines.title: Emergency numbers
helplines.intro: These work without internet. One tap opens your dialer — you still press call.

name.allNote: Police, fire and ambulance on one number

helplines.sourceStale: The district's own page was last updated {{pageUpdated}}, so a landline may have changed. The short numbers do not change.

services.intro: Emergency numbers are here now. The rest of this tab is still being built.

rides.title: Rides
rides.prototypeBody: Rides are being tested. Drivers here are not checked by anyone yet, and Bespa takes no payment. Always call the driver before you travel.
rides.offline: No connection. A seat has to be claimed live, so this cannot wait.
rides.empty: No rides posted yet. If you drive, you can post one.
rides.noMatch: No rides on that route yet.
rides.holdNote: Seats are held for 10 minutes while you finish.
rides.heldSome: You got {{got}} of {{asked}} seats — somebody else was choosing at the same time.
rides.heldNone: Somebody else took that seat. Pick another.
rides.phoneHint: The driver will call this number.
rides.pickup: Where should the driver pick you up?
rides.payNote: Pay the driver directly in cash or by scanning their QR at the end of the journey. Bespa does not collect payment.
rides.registrationHint: Optional, but passengers look for it
rides.needVehicle: Tell us what you drive first. A trip needs to know how many seats it has.
rides.pickupArea: Where will you pick people up?
rides.published: Posted. Passengers can see it now.
rides.cancelReasonRequired: Say why — passengers are owed a reason.
rides.tripCancelled: Trip cancelled. Everyone who booked has been told.
rides.needRoute: Enter where you are going from and to.
rides.needDate: Choose the day you are travelling.
rides.vehicleIntro: Asked once. Your next trip will not ask again.
rides.needDifferent: The two places must be different.
rides.tooManySeats: That is more seats than your vehicle has.
rides.pickupAreaHint: Optional. For example: from the taxi stand
rides.segShortHint: Leaving in the next few minutes

board.title: Leaving now
board.intro: Drivers at the stand right now. No booking — turn up, or tell them you are coming.
board.empty: No vans on the board. If you drive, you can go live.
board.comingNote: Tells the driver. Seats are first-come — this holds nothing.
board.claimSent: Told the driver. Go to the stand.
board.goLiveTitle: Put your van on the board
board.goLiveIntro: You will show for 45 minutes, then drop off by yourself.
board.seatsNow: How many seats are free right now?

rides.tripNoteHint: Optional. For example: I can collect you from your house in town.
rides.seatNotForSale: Seat {{number}}, not for sale on this trip
rides.confirmNeeds: Add your phone number and where to pick you up.

driver.title: Confirm you drive a taxi
driver.intro: We only confirm that you drive a taxi. No Aadhaar, no bank details — just the papers the RTO has already given you.
driver.reviewTime: Review usually takes a few hours.
driver.gateNote: Your licence has to be checked before you can post a trip or go live. The other two are optional.
driver.verifiedNote: You are verified. You can post trips and go live.

doc.permitSub: RTO route or tourist taxi permit
doc.badgeSub: Driver badge from the transport office

driver.notVerifiedYet: Your licence has not been checked yet.
driver.queueIntro: Oldest first. A driver cannot post a trip until their licence is checked.
driver.reason: Why? (only if you send it back)
driver.reasonHint: The driver reads this and sends another photo.
driver.reasonRequired: Say why, so they know what to send.
driver.laterHint: You can send them any time from the Rides tab
driver.queueHint: Check licences so drivers can post trips
